sn22.43:1.2: This was famously one of the last teachings of the Buddha ([dn16:2.26.1]()).
sn22.43:1.3: Compare the Bodhisatta’s reflection at [sn12.10](). | Readings vary, but surely for _yoni upaparikkhitabbā_ we should accept the variant _yoniso_ (“rationally”; literally “by way of source”), as also found at [sn22.95:2.1]().
sn22.43:3.2: For “quenched in that respect” (_tadaṅganibbuta_) see [an9.33]() and [an9.50]().
